title: Press
content: Press Heyscotty 2026-02-06T18:14:04+00:00 Press & Media Thank you for your continued support. Press badges are provided to editors, writers, publishers, and editorial employees of official publications may attend Pittcon at no charge. All final press credentialing decisions are at the discretion of Show management. Registered journalists must wear their current Show media badges at all times when on the exhibition floor and when attending Show-related events. View Media Qualifications Press Room – Room 215 The Pittcon Press Room serves as a “base” for registered media representatives. Here, members of the international science and business media communities will have exclusive access to press releases, press packets, events, and the press conference schedule. The media room is a resource area for information and collaboration. Press Registration Press Room Days + Hours Sunday – Tuesday: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM Wednesday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM Questions? If you would like to set up an interview, or have any questions regarding publicity or the press room, please contact: 800-825-3221 x 203 publicity@pittcon.org Press Conferences View scheduled exhibitor Press Conferences View Schedule Media Qualifications Proper credentials are required on-site in order to receive a Media Badge. If proper credentials are not provided either pre-show or on-site, you may be denied access to the show. Qualifications of all media outlets will be determined by the Pittcon media registration staff. To receive a complimentary Media Registration, media must be a qualified representative from one of the following news organizations: Trade Publication News Publication Business Publication Consumer Publication Newspaper Wire Service Radio Station Television Station Generally, representatives of the media who qualify have the following titles: Editor Reporter Editorial writer Publisher Associate Publisher Photographer Camera Crew Request to Attend Pittcon as Media/Press Contact Name * First Last Email * Affiliation / Company * Publication * Your Role * JOIN NOW Δ
